note: Aspects retained for the analysis after human check round 1 (annotation/PROTOCOL.md section 7; results/annotation_study/). Frozen before any contrast between study groups was examined. Do not edit; any later change is a documented deviation.

sat.poles: muted desaturated colors <-> vivid saturated colors

medium.poles: a photograph <-> a painting or illustration

shot.poles: extreme close-up <-> wide shot from far away

tone.poles: modern photo with natural neutral colors <-> vintage photo with sepia brown tones
tone.reading: a warm, yellowed, vintage-photo look; it also carries the warm/cool signal of lighting (the anchor pilot showed light, tone and mood move together), so light and mood are not analysed separately

bg.poles: plain simple background <-> busy detailed background

passed_but_not_analysed.mood: coupled with tone; tone chosen by the owner
passed_but_not_analysed.inout: mostly implied by the subject; unstable can't-tell rate; shown in the tool only

primary_tests: Q1: 2 families (klein-base 4B G07->G06, Qwen-Image-2512 G10->G09) x 5 aspects x {location, concentration} = 20 tests, Holm-corrected together (frozen_margins.json)
